source_note: UESP page itself blocked direct tool fetch with HTTP 403, so the immediate implementation was based on the user-provided UESP screenshots plus the existing parser's mapped fields.
changes: Added Raw Editor -> Format Reference tab.
Added searchable UESP-style structure map for File, Header, Plugin Info, Light Plugin Info, File Location Table, Global Data, RefID, Change Form, Change Form Types, and Unknown 3 Table.
Kept the new tab documentation-only; actual writable bytes remain in Mapped Fields with fixed-size safety checks.
Updated Raw Editor notes to point users toward the new reference map.
No direct missing-item insertion behavior was changed in this patch.
next_mapping_targets: Use File Location Table offsets to build navigable section jump links.
Use Global Data type map to label parsed global-data rows more clearly.
Use Change Form type map to decode raw type bytes into record codes in the Change Forms tab.
Map actual player stats/actor values from non-header data before enabling edits.
